warning.titlePre: Mercedes Vito OM642 Swirl Flap & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your Vito 119/120/122/123 is a diesel model with the OM642 V6 - that's the W639 generation - swirl flap and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.

Petrol models with the M272 V6 don't share this specific issue - the M272 is a different engine family with its own characteristics, and no independently confirmed pattern of failure has been established for this application.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern, multiple TSBs, per VRF-mercedes-vito.md. M272 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to diesel V6 only
